title: Gothic Domina and Pet
description: A dominant woman in a black and pink gothic dress with a crown stands holding a chain leash attached to a kneeling submissive woman in a pink corset and fishnets. They are positioned on a stone path in front of a large purple gothic cathedral, with a floating female figure entwined in pink roses on the right.
prompt: A dominant blonde woman wearing a spiked crown, black and hot pink gothic dress with high collar and thigh-high slit, long black gloves, stands holding a rosary and a chain leash. The leash is attached to a submissive woman with short black hair, wearing a pink corset, fishnet stockings and collar, kneeling on a stone path with chalk pentagram. Behind them is a massive purple gothic cathedral with rose window and statue. On the right, a floating ethereal woman is entwined in pink roses and vines. Dramatic pink and purple lighting, dark fantasy atmosphere.
